# myphone-group-orders-faqs


**FAQs When will my order ship? Your MyPhone will ship within 2-3 business days after placing the order. We will send tracking information once your order ships. How will my order be delivered? Sunnyvale, CA - Thursday, September 10th, 2026


## FAQs


When will my order ship?


Your MyPhone will ship within 2-3 business days after placing the order. We will send tracking information once your order ships.


How will my order be delivered?


Your MyPhone will be shipped directly to your home.


What’s included with MyPhone?


Each MyPhone includes the phone, Base Station, charging cable—and a surprise sticker pack! Home phone service is $7.99 per month, plus applicable taxes and fees.


How does MyPhone help keep kids safe?


MyPhone includes features like Trusted Circle, Quiet Hours, Address-Based 911, and Call Log, helping kids stay connected while giving parents added peace of mind.


What do I need to get started?


Getting started is easy! Use the Ooma Setup app to connect your Base Station to Wi-Fi, plug in your MyPhone, and you’ll be ready to make calls in about 15 minutes.


Who can I contact for support?


Our support team is here to help! Call us at877-353-5185 .


### About Ooma, Inc.


Ooma (NYSE: OOMA) creates powerful connected experiences for businesses and consumers, delivered from its smart cloud-based SaaS platform. For businesses of all sizes, Ooma provides advanced voice and collaboration features that are flexible and scalable. For consumers, Ooma’s residential phone service provides PureVoice HD voice quality, advanced functionality and integration with mobile devices. Ooma’s innovative smart security solution delivers a range of wireless security sensors that make it easy for anyone to protect their home or business. Learn more at[www.ooma.com](https://www.ooma.com/) .
